text:
Maya: quick sync — post-launch decisions. we need to decide whether to fold the two small UX polish items into the hotpatch or push them to next mini-wave. p0 crash for Acme is already in the hotpatch obviously.
Sahil: agreed on crash being p0. what are the UX items exactly?
Maya: 1) search autoscroll jitter (customer reported, low repro) 2) inline token counter for prompt editor (small UX win). both are small dev effort but add QA time.
Jenna: timeline constraint: QE only has a 48hr window for smoke next week. if we add the counter we might exceed that.
Kevin: can the counter be behind a feature flag? if so we could ship with flag off and enable in dedicated customers later.
Toni: counter behind flag seems low risk. but the autoscroll bug is customer-facing and might affect conversion — leaning include in hotpatch.
Maya: proposal: hotpatch v1.1.1 = p0 crash + autoscroll fix + infra rollback hooks. v1.2 (mini-wave) = token counter + 2 non-blocking enhancements. hotpatch target: canary Tue 10:00 PST, full roll Wed.
Sahil: can we quantify risk/benefit quickly? what % of sessions hit autoscroll problem and what's conversion delta?
Jenna: analytics -> autoscroll shows up in ~0.6% of interactive sessions, but on Acme it's 3% because of their long prompts. conversion drop ~ 1.2% for that cohort.
Kevin: ops note: rolling the hotpatch during Tue morning is fine but we need a rollback playbook in case KV cache migration regresses. I can own rollback runbook.
Maya: thanks — assign: Sahil owns autoscroll fix PR, Jenna owns QE plan, Kevin owns rollback/runbook, Toni owns feature flag for counter. I'll coordinate release notes and customer comms.
Toni: quick question — if we put the counter behind flag do we need an experiment? would prefer to avoid extra telemetry in hotpatch.
Maya: no experiment in hotpatch. flag default off, enable for internal only. experiment can launch with v1.2 after mini-wave.
deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled: v1.1.1 -> Tue 10:00 PST to group "canary-small". All checks: smoke, perf, error-rate.
Sahil: timeline check — I can cut a PR by EOD Mon, but need a 2hr pairing with Jenna for test cases.
Jenna: I can pair Mon 11:30am. QE plan: 8 smoke test cases + 3 regression scenarios for Acme. need clear rollback criteria (p99 latency increase > 15% or error-rate > 0.3%).
Kevin: noted rollback criteria. I'll add automated alerts for both.
Maya: decision summary: include autoscroll in v1.1.1; token counter deferred to v1.2 behind a flag. owners noted. ship canary Tue. customer comms draft will go to #customer-success for review by EOD Mon.
Sahil: :thumbsup:
Toni: :eyes: will prep flag and feature toggle docs.
Jenna: QE will be ready.
Kevin: prepping rollback playbook and alerts.
Maya: thanks team — quick follow-up: if any blocker pops up tonight ping me and add to the thread. otherwise we'll meet Tue 9:30 for pre-canary check.
Sahil: acknowledged.
Jenna: ack.
Kevin: ack.
Toni: ack.
